summary: PORTADD is a batch program that creates new portfolio records. It opens the indexed PORTFILE (I-O) and a sequential input file, then reads each input record and validates it (portfolio ID and client name must be present, status must be 'A'). Valid records are date-stamped (create date and last-maintenance date set to today) and written to the portfolio file; the write outcome is classified as added, duplicate, or error and counted. At the end it closes the files, prints add/duplicate/error totals, and sets the job return code. Error conditions handled: file-open failure, invalid input data, and duplicate/other write errors.

paragraphs.name: 0000-MAIN
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CALL 1000-INITIALIZE
WHILE NOT end of file DO
  CALL 2000-PROCESS
END WHILE
CALL 3000-TERMINATE
RETURN to caller (GOBACK)

paragraphs.name: 1000-INITIALIZE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLEAR WS-WORK-AREAS (INITIALIZE)
ACCEPT WS-CURRENT-DATE FROM system date (YYYYMMDD)
OPEN PORTFOLIO-FILE for READ-WRITE (I-O)
OPEN INPUT-FILE for READ-ONLY
IF portfolio open NOT success OR input open NOT success THEN
  DISPLAY 'Error opening files' + statuses
  SET WS-RETURN-CODE = error (8)
  CALL 3000-TERMINATE
END IF
branches: IF file open failed (either file) -> terminate

annotations.note: SME REVIEW: on open failure it PERFORMs 3000-TERMINATE (which CLOSEs the files) but does NOT stop the run — control returns to 0000-MAIN, which then PERFORMs 2000-PROCESS against now-closed files. Likely a defect (missing STOP RUN / GOBACK after the error).

paragraphs.name: 2000-PROCESS
paragraphs.pseudocode:
READ next record from INPUT-FILE into PORT-RECORD
IF end of file THEN
  SET END-OF-FILE = true
ELSE
  CALL 2100-VALIDATE-AND-ADD
END IF
branches: READ ... AT END / NOT AT END

paragraphs.name: 2100-VALIDATE-AND-ADD
paragraphs.pseudocode:
-- Validation rule
IF PORT-ID is blank OR PORT-CLIENT-NAME is blank OR PORT-STATUS <> 'A' THEN
  INCREMENT WS-ERROR-COUNT
  DISPLAY 'Invalid record data' + PORT-ID
  EXIT PARAGRAPH        -- skip this record
END IF
SET PORT-CREATE-DATE = WS-CURRENT-DATE
SET PORT-LAST-MAINT  = WS-CURRENT-DATE
WRITE PORT-RECORD to PORTFOLIO-FILE
SELECT CASE write status
  WHEN success ('00'): INCREMENT WS-ADD-COUNT
  WHEN duplicate ('22'): INCREMENT WS-DUP-COUNT; DISPLAY 'Duplicate record' + PORT-ID
  ELSE: INCREMENT WS-ERROR-COUNT; DISPLAY 'Write error for' + PORT-ID
END SELECT
branches: IF invalid (ID/client blank or status<>'A') -> count error + skip
EVALUATE write status: success / duplicate / other

annotations.note: EXIT PARAGRAPH is an early return that skips the add for an invalid record.
Business rule: a record is only added when status = 'A' (active) and both ID and client name are present.

paragraphs.name: 3000-TERMINATE
paragraphs.pseudocode:
CLOSE PORTFOLIO-FILE and INPUT-FILE
DISPLAY 'Records added', 'Duplicate records', 'Errors occurred' with their counts
SET job RETURN-CODE = WS-RETURN-CODE

annotations.note: Can be entered twice (once from the open-error path in 1000, once normally) — a double CLOSE may itself set a bad file status.
